Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Tassel Diamond Throw Pillow - 18 x 18 Inch, Black / White
Colors: Black/White
The variegated black yarn of this modern throw pillow accentuates the stripes of the white-and-black diamond in its center, surrounded by soft white tassels for added flair and style. Cotton/polyester Imported 18"L x 18"W Handwoven and hand-stitched tassels are an added detail that make this pillow truly special. The space-dyed yarn means the color variations are soft and muted. 1 throw pillow Spot clean with a damp cloth, and then allow to air dry. Rather than pulling at any loose threads, please use scissors to trim them.
